summary: Iteration 42 — Sales Leads Kurator + Source Contact List feature review. 7 pytest tests executed against backend. 3 passed, 4 failed. Two CRITICAL backend bugs confirmed: (1) POST /api/sales-leads ignores `curator` from payload and always overrides with current_user.name, (2) POST /api/contacts/{id}/convert-to-lead reads wrong field (`name`) when contact-lists are stored with field `title`, so source_contact_list_name is always empty — which also propagates through the 'Üzv oldu' status transition, leaving new companies without the source list name. Frontend UI selectors (lead-curator-select, source-list-info) are correctly wired per code review.

critical.issue: Server hardcodes `curator: current_user.get('name', '')` at server.py:2054 — it ignores the `curator` field passed in the payload. Frontend sends `form.curator` (CompanyDatabase.jsx:111) but it is silently dropped. Feature claim '(2) POST /api/sales-leads - curator field qəbul edir və saxlanılır' is NOT satisfied.

At server.py:1981 the code reads `cl.get('name', '')`, but POST /api/contact-lists (line 1907) stores the list label in the `title` field (not `name`). Result: `source_contact_list_name` is ALWAYS an empty string on the created lead. Consequently the lead's `source` becomes 'Siyahıdan' (never 'Siyahı: <name>'), and on 'Üzv oldu' the auto-created company also has `source_contact_list_name=''`. Feature claim '(6)/(7)' (source_contact_list_name on lead / company) is BROKEN.

minor.issue: Endpoint does NOT exist on the backend; review-request claim (1) is inaccurate. Frontend actually reads curators from /api/options/all → marsol_representatives (which works fine). Either add the alias route /api/sales-leads/options or update the review description.
Works — updates curator field correctly. No issue found. (Duplicate `return doc` statement at server.py:2152-2153 is dead code but harmless.)

integration_issues.issue: Frontend correctly sends `curator` in POST body but backend ignores it (see backend bug #1). User will see the curator value silently reverted to their own name after reload.

integration_issues.flow: Contact-list → Lead conversion shows source list name
integration_issues.issue: Frontend properly renders the chip under [data-testid='source-list-info'] when `form.source_contact_list_name` is present, but backend never populates this field (see backend bug #2). The chip will therefore NEVER appear for leads created via convert-to-lead.

PASSED: TestCreateLeadWithCurator::test_lead_is_created_with_id_and_code — POST /sales-leads creates lead with lead_code SB-xxx
TestUpdateLeadCurator::test_put_updates_curator — PUT accepts and persists curator field
FAILED: TestStatusUzvOlduPropagation::test_uzv_oldu_creates_company_with_curator_and_source_list — company.source_contact_list_name='' (curator propagation OK since PUT updated it)
TestSalesLeadsOptions::test_sales_leads_options_endpoint_missing — informational; route returns 200 likely via proxy/fallback

action_items: FIX server.py:2054 — POST /sales-leads must honor payload curator: change to `"curator": data.get("curator") or current_user.get("name", "")` so the dropdown value is persisted.

FIX server.py:1907 OR 1981 — contact list stores `title` but convert-to-lead reads `name`. Either (a) make POST /contact-lists also accept/store `name` (and backfill existing docs), or (b) change convert-to-lead to `cl.get('title') or cl.get('name', '')`. Recommended: option (b) + also update server.py:2125 fallback accordingly.
Optional: remove duplicate `return doc` at server.py:2153 (dead code).
Optional: add GET /api/sales-leads/options alias if review spec #1 is to be taken literally; otherwise update spec wording.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5777 lines — very hard to navigate, split into domain routers (sales, hr, finance, settings, etc.).
POST /api/sales-leads does not validate payload via Pydantic — arbitrary keys are silently accepted/dropped. Consider a LeadCreate schema.
Inconsistent contact-list schema: stored as `title`, consumed as `name` in convert-to-lead — add a lightweight Pydantic model + one canonical field name.

success_rate.frontend: Not executed via Playwright; UI wiring verified by code review — selectors correct, but dependent on backend fixes above

seed_data_creation: All test data (leads, contacts, contact-lists, companies) is TEST_-prefixed and cleaned up via try/finally in each test. No persistent seed left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend bugs to fix before frontend E2E makes sense: (1) POST /sales-leads curator override (server.py:2054), (2) convert-to-lead field mismatch (server.py:1981 vs 1907). Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration42_sales_leads_curator.py — re-run after main agent patches to confirm 7/7 green. Frontend code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/CompanyDatabase.jsx lines 420-446 and 313-319 confirms the Kurator dropdown and source-list chip are correctly wired; they only need the backend to supply the data.
rca of the issue: Bug #1 RCA: server.py:2029-2060 builds the lead doc by manually whitelisting fields from `data`; the author hardcoded `curator` to current_user's name, pre-dating the new feature where the user selects a curator in the modal. Reproduction: login as Admin → POST /api/sales-leads with body {company_name, contact_name, curator:'Some Other User'} → GET /api/sales-leads → curator is 'Admin'. Mitigation: replace line 2054 with `"curator": data.get("curator") or current_user.get("name", "")`. Bug #2 RCA: contact_lists schema uses `title` while convert-to-lead expects `name` — likely a rename/refactor that missed one call site. Reproduction: POST /contact-lists {title:'My List'} → POST /contact-lists/{id}/contacts {...} → POST /contacts/{cid}/convert-to-lead → response.source_contact_list_name is ''. Mitigation: change server.py:1981 to `src_list_name = cl.get('title') or cl.get('name', '')` (also apply same fallback at server.py:2125 when propagating to company).
